reviewed_routes.note_en: Regional self-guided journey includes driving and ferries between groups. The overview is not one continuous walking route. Historic guide details may be outdated.

reviewed_routes.note_en: Historic accounts include Shrine-to-Cathedral and Orlu-to-Shrine processions. They are event-specific variants, not proof of the currently listed 30 km annual procession route.
